objective: Build a 24x7 autonomous multi-agent client acquisition & outreach system for Jesora Tech with real-time web dashboard, lead finder, email dispatch, inbox monitoring, meeting scheduler, and instant notifications
acceptance_criteria: Modular multi-agent system implemented with LeadScout, PitchCrafter, Dispatcher, InboxMonitor, MeetingCloser, and NotificationSentinel
Persistent SQLite database schema with migrations for leads, campaigns, outreach sequences, email logs, meetings, and agent activity audits
24x7 autonomous scheduler engine with configurable intervals, warm-up throttling, anti-spam pacing, and timezone management
Jesora Tech specialized intelligence with case studies (WriteWell, MotoFix, Razzle, etc.), service capabilities, and AI personalization prompts
Unified API & Webhook layer for lead generation, sequence scheduling, inbox processing, and Telegram/Webhook notifications
High-end Executive Web Dashboard with live agent telemetry, CRM pipeline, campaign manager, unified inbox, and settings configuration
Automated end-to-end test suite passing all verification checks
Self-contained startup scripts and comprehensive README documentation
non_goals: Do not hardcode production API credentials or private keys in source control
Do not depend on external paid cloud services for core local functionality
